snippet.title: PlayStation - Striker 96 (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Striker '96 captures all the excitement, thrills and atmosphere (without the dodgy dealings) of the game itself. Striker '96 also gives you perfectly animated players, unbelievably fast 3D graphics, ultra smooth panning angles, and indoor and outdoor pitches with excellent special effects which will leave you breathless with the realism of it all.
